glosses: point (the sharp tip of an object)
a cylindrical nail without a head or with a very small one

examples.text: Je veux éviter les heures de pointe.
examples.en: I want to avoid rush hour.

examples.text: Ne me pointe pas du doigt !
examples.en: Don't point your finger at me.

examples.text: La pointe du couteau est aiguisée.
examples.en: The tip of the knife is sharp.

examples.text: Ne pointe pas ton arme vers quiconque !
examples.en: Don't point your gun at anyone.
